tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// rgyal sras thu bo mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// de yis rjes bzung rje btsun sa skya pa// skyabs mchog mtshungs med gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin bsod nams rtse// mdo rgyud kun mkhyen rje btsun rin po che// thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇḍi ta// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab gsum la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa rin po che// thos bsam bsgom pas rgyud phyug dkon mchog dpal// dngos grub mchog brnyes chos rje brag phug pa// mkhas grub dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs// skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// gdams pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan te// 'dren mchog bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la gsol 'debs kyi// myur mgyogs thugs rje'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// phung khrol gzhir gyur tshe 'di'i snang ba la// zhen pa gting nas log par byin gyis rlobs// cung zad tsam yang bde ba'i skabs med cing*// bzod dka'i sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad pas// rgyun tu gdung byed khams gsum 'khor ba la// nges 'byung drag po skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don tu legs bsgoms nas// rang don yid byed bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ (306)chos kun gdod nas rmi lam sgyu ma ltar// snang yang bden med stong par thag chod nas// phyogs 'dzin kun bral zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam// yang dag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ 'bras bu'i kha skong ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas blo sems chos 'gro zhing*// chos kun lam 'gro lam gyi 'khrul pa kun// so sor sel nas 'khrul snang sangs rgyas kyi// ye shes chen por 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/

zhes pa 'di ni zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba'o// ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ 'dren mchog bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ ces pa'i mtshams rgyal bas lung bstan kun mkhyen e waṃ pa// de sras thu bo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// smra ba'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge ste// rig grol mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' dbang phyug zhabs// lung rig mnga' bdag kun dga' legs grub ste// bstan pa'i gsal byed gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rig par smra ba kun dga' chos grags dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rnam par rgyal// mkhyen rab mthar phyin bstan 'dzin bzang po ste// rnam 'dren dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' shing grub brnyes ngag dbang lhun grub dang*/ kun gzigs chos kyi nyi ma rmor chen rje// gdams pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas gnas gsar ba// mtshungs med bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus bstan pa'i srog shing kun blo'i zhabs// rje (307)btsun 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen te// skye rgu'i 'dren mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa'i thugs rjes sras bcas rgyal ba kun// lhar bcas dga' ba'i bstan 'dzin mchog gi skur// yongs shar skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid che// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la sogs sbrel lo// ces pa'ang dge slong bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling du bris pa shu bhaṃ/
